To populate: fetch the cited source document, copy a short (2-5 sentence) representative excerpt for that exact ICH section, and record its precise citation (document title, NDA/application number, page/section if available). Until a record's exemplar_text is non-empty, exemplar_retriever.py skips it and Tier 3 no-ops for that section_id — this is intentional graceful degradation, not a bug.
